summary: D-Wave Quantum filed an 8-K/A amending its September 8, 2026 report on a Department of Commerce Other Transaction Agreement worth up to $100 million. On September 8, 2026, D-Wave executed a Securities Issuance Agreement and issued 7,095,721 unregistered common shares to the Department at $14.093 per share, raising roughly $100 million in non-cash consideration tied to the award. Shares were sold under Section 4(a)(2) exemption. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date stated. Watch for dilution, registration rights, and government ownership overhang.
